about_short_description.short_description: Coldreach is a digital platform that generates hyper-personalized sales emails.

product.name: AI SDR
product.description: An AI-driven sales development representative that monitors ideal customer profiles 24/7, identifies relevant buying signals, and automates personalized outreach to book meetings.

product.name: Signal Engine
product.description: A data engine that tracks and analyzes over 79 million companies in real time to identify buying signals based on customizable criteria.

product.name: Campaign Builder
product.description: A tool to create targeted outbound sales campaigns by building lead lists and initiating personalized outreach using AI.

product.name: Autopilot
product.description: An automated outreach system that continuously sends personalized emails to qualified leads based on real-time buying signals.

product.name: Live Dashboard
product.description: A monitoring interface that provides real-time insights into email campaign performance, deliverability, and domain health.
